improvements: st-008 is judged by reading the code; add a grader check that snapshots the tree's paths, sizes and mtimes before and after a run and fails on any change, so it becomes a proof rather than an LLM judgement.

st-005 says symlinks are never followed, but cli.validateDirectory resolves a symlinked root argument with filepath.EvalSymlinks. The behaviour is sensible, but the criterion should say whether a symlinked root argument is in scope so the grader can pin it.
st-002 names 'every automated test' but the POSIX requirement is only checked by reading the script; a `dash bin/test.sh` run in the grader would make the shell requirement observable.
